authority_scope: Robustness Guardian, Advanced CSV, Alpha Synthesis, Microstructure Sensor Grid, Apex Council only

first_repository_action.rule: After one fresh read for SHA and monotonic RUN_ID check, write the canonical receipt immediately. No startup-state write is required or permitted before it.
first_repository_action.same_run_idempotency: Same RUN_ID is already complete only when every valid_receipt_requirements field matches. A malformed same-RUN receipt must not be accepted as success; repair once from fresh SHA if safe, otherwise fail closed and let watchdog record MALFORMED_CANONICAL_RECEIPT.

monotonicity.finalization_state: Never overwrite an existing lexicographically newer RUN_ID. Same RUN_ID may be rewritten only to repair a structurally invalid canonical receipt; a structurally valid same-RUN receipt is immutable/idempotent.
monotonicity.heartbeat: Never overwrite a heartbeat with an older RUN_ID.
monotonicity.evidence_state: Never overwrite evidence_state with an older RUN_ID.

optional_after_receipt.heartbeat: Best-effort mirror binding exact finalization commit/blob. Failure does not downgrade the receipt.
optional_after_receipt.evidence_state: At most one bounded evidence call, then one evidence-state write. Substantive consumers use evidence_state, not the durability receipt.
optional_after_receipt.startup_state: Legacy compatibility only. V5.7 workers do not write STARTED. Watchdog may clear stranded pre-V5.7 markers.

scheduler_rule: Workers must never call scheduler/task-management tools or mutate enabled state, IDs, titles, schedules, timezone, or siblings.
watchdog_rule: Recovery-only. May repair heartbeat from a newer canonical receipt and clean legacy startup markers; must never move RUN_ID state backward or fabricate evidence.
